question: How does the review get from the known global cobalt reserves to the cobalt usable for batteries, and what amount results?
expect: ~7 million metric tons of reserves x ~70% mining efficiency x ~40% directed to batteries = ~2 million metric tons (p1.L42-47, Fig. 1 caption)
rendered: The review states that it uses metrics from known global cobalt reserves, approximately 7 million metric tons. However, it assumes a conservative mining efficiency of approximately 70% and that only about 40% of the mined cobalt is directed toward battery manufacturing.
